text:
incident-bot: PAGED: P1 — hosted-api us-east request queue surge. queue depth: 45k -> 52k, p95=3.2s, p99=12.4s, error rate 5%. Auto-scaler attempting grow but failing. See dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/req-queue-us-east

sasha: oncall here, taking lead. :pager:

jamal: joining. initial triage: gpu pool 'us-east-gpu-pool-1' shows 0 available nodes, pending scale requests piling up. autoscaler logs show repeated 403 quota errors.

kevin: quick check — are we hitting cloud GPU quota or internal thin-pool limits?

jamal: looks like cloud quota. autoscaler tried to request +12 gpus, cloud returned "Quota exceeded: GPUs" at 2024-11-08T02:51:10Z. snippet: 
```
2024-11-08T02:51:10Z autoscaler.go:220 scaleRequest: desired=12 -> request failed: {Code:QuotaExceeded Message:"Requested GPUs (12) exceeds quota (8)"}
```

sasha: ok. customer impact: Host API p99 12s, some requests timing out (504). Most affected are large-context generation tenants + retries. Not yet full outage but severe latency 

miriam: posting runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/hosted-queue-autoscale-failure. steps: 1) verify quota 2) reduce bursty tenants 3) route traffic to fallback models/regions 4) request emergency quota increase.

ops-runbook-bot: runbook triggered by sasha. checklist created: RB-3842.

kevin: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily enable model-variant fallback (cpu-quantized) for low-priority tenants to reduce GPU pressure; 2) apply selective rate limit for 'campaign' tenant hitting the spike; 3) manually provision from dedicated pool if quota cannot be raised immediately.

jamal: executing step 1 now. command: 
```
POST /v1/tenants/cfg/fallback
{ "tenant": "public-campaign", "fallback_model": "gpt-small-quant-cpu", "duration": "30m" }
```

sasha: rate-limit rule in firehose -> creating token bucket rule: 
```
/ratelimits apply --tenant=campaign --rps=20
```

ops-runbook-bot: applied rule RB-3842:campaign rate-limit by sasha.

jamal: autoscaler still failing to request new GPUs. opened emergency support ticket with cloud provider (INC-90012). ETA on quota decision unknown.

kevin: meanwhile I'm spinning up 6 reserved gpus from dedicated pool 'dedicated-short' and wiring routing. command: 
```
infra-cli allocate --pool dedicated-short --gpus 6 --label temp-relief
```

miriam: be careful with cost — authorize only for 60min.

kevin: allocated and routing change applied. requests are moving to new nodes, p95 dropping to 1.1s after 3m. p99 now 4.6s and falling. :thumbsup:

sasha: good. continuing to monitor. open items: cloud quota increase request, follow-up for autoscaler to surface quota rejections more clearly, add prioritized tenant throttles to runbook.

jamal: collecting logs for postmortem: autoscaler request IDs, cloud response bodies, affected tenant IDs, top slow endpoints. dumping snapshot: 
```
curl -s https://logs.internal/api/query?range=5m&query="quotaExceeded" | head -n 50
```
```
2024-11-08T02:50:59Z cloudapi: RequestID=abc123 quotaExceeded: GPUs available=8 requested=20
2024-11-08T02:51:10Z autoscaler: scaleRequest failed for cluster us-east-gpu-pool-1 requestID=abc123
```

miriam: assigning postmortem owner: miriam. expected write-up target: 72h. add mitigation followups: - autoscaler retry/backoff tuning - pre-warm heuristics for scheduled campaigns - tenant-level circuit-breakers - emergency dedicated pool playbook

kevin: handoff to overnight oncall jamal in 30m. jamal, please escalate to cloud quota team in the morning if quota request still pending.

jamal: will do. setting calendar reminder and notifying sales for high-SLA customers impacted. message to sales: 
"We experienced a hosted-api latency spike tied to GPU quota limits; customers A/B impacted; mitigation applied (fallback + dedicated nodes). We will follow up with timeline."

sasha: closing note: incident downgraded to P2 at 03:15 after routing relief. queue stabilized at 6k. monitoring alerts remain active for p99>5s. will reopen if regression.

ops-runbook-bot: incident RB-3842 updated: status=stabilized, severity=P2, linked-ticket=INC-90012, postmortem-owner=miriam.

miriam: thanks team. handoff complete to jamal for overnight watch. I'll start the postmortem draft in the morning.

jamal: acknowledged. :headphones:

kevin: nice work. we'll follow up on quotas and runbook changes.

incident-bot: Note: this thread will be archived in 7 days. For urgent reopen, react with :rotating_light:.
